name: embedding_index
summary: In-memory cosine-similarity index over stream_encoder's continuous output. Lets dim_pack look up a real CLIP vector by crystal_id, and supports semantic retrieval ('find me the 10 events nearest to the sentence: golden vortex memecoin launch'). Stdlib path uses linear scan; numpy path uses a single matmul. Below ~100k entries the difference is invisible; above that, swap in FAISS via the same find_nearest body.
engine_pattern: Lazy module-level singleton. Loaded on first use (auto-loads packed binary from disk if present). Add/query/save/load API. Numpy is optional; if absent we fall back to a stdlib list-of-lists with dot-product cosine.

persistence.metadata_jsonl: ~/.cc/embeddings/_index_meta.jsonl  (one IndexedEvent per row, in row order)

api: reload_today() -> int   (wipe + ingest today's encoder JSONL)
cc_dispatchers: cc embed-ingest [path]                # default: today's encoder JSONL

smoke_test_2026_05_29.stdlib_path: verified (have_numpy=false; linear-scan cosine works for v0)
smoke_test_2026_05_29.numpy_path: lazily-detected — if numpy lands later via venv, persistence stays binary-compatible (same row-major float32 layout)

wires_dim_pack: dimension_pack._vector_hex_64 calls embedding_index.get_singleton().find_by_crystal(crystal_id). When the encoder has seen the event, dim_pack returns the first 32 bytes of its real CLIP vector as the vec64. Otherwise falls through to SHA-256.
